items.text: It's been a while since our last update, but we've been hard at work bringing you a comprehensive collection of improvements and fixes!
Graphical changes over time on Volare are now shown correctly
A certain character no longer appears in various places after they have supposedly died
Certain possible crew mates no longer show up if they weren't recruited
Fixed a softlock that could occur when killing a shielded frog with an arrow fired by another frog
Fixed a case in Bygone where you could fall through the ground after talking with Sermo
It is now possible to talk to Cath when first sailing away from Pono
Fixed the text for the first donation to the Videra so it no longer indicates that there is a cave somewhere
You now correctly pay for the Aufero INA tournament
Removed the possibility of obtaining unlimited INA tokens from a certain character
Fixed a softlock that could occur when donating if you didn't donate the maximum amount
Rolling while in water now correctly puts you into the underwater state
Sharks now face the correct direction when preparing to jump out of the water
Various fixes to enemy behavior
Added location titles to some areas when arriving with Volare
Fixed a case where Fig couldn't find a valid respawn position at the end of a slope
Fixes to obtaining the stealth achievement
Fixed a softlock that could occur if you chose to leave the area right before Mangroves Town
General improvements to camera work
Various minor localization fixes
Memory and performance optimizations
Various fixes to traversal in several levels
Fixes to conversation timing and animations
Added names to the credits
General UI fixes
Various Graphical fixes to environment in several levels
Other fixes and improvements

Fix to shark enemies which could make them sink too deep and roll around

Made sure certain characters where gone, when they should be gone

Various fixes to dialogs and cutscenes

We’re excited to announce the release of patch 1.1.0 — our most stable patch yet!

Our team has been working hard to reproduce and resolve the issues you’ve reported, along with additional bugs uncovered by our QA team. As a small team, we truly appreciate your support and detailed feedback, it’s been invaluable in improving the game.
Thank you for being part of the journey, and we hope you enjoy the experience! <3

First off, thank you for all your feedback since launch.

We’ve been closely reading your reports, forum threads, reviews, and messages. It’s clear there are more issues than we are comfortable with, and your input helped us quickly identify what needed attention first.
We’re committed to continuously release patches as quickly as possible until Forgotlings is at the level it’s meant to be!
We'd really like for you to play and judge for yourself and continue sharing your favourite moments/aspects.
Throughline Games Team
